source_title: Brand-New Day One Xbox Game Pass Game Confirmed for January 27 - GameRant
source_excerpt:
Tropico 7 is coming to Xbox Game Pass on January 27, 2027. Its release date announcement, which amounts to a small delay, also makes it the second officially confirmed Xbox Game Pass catalog addition for January 2027.
Tropico 7 will arrive nearly eight years after the previous mainline installment in the long-running city-builder franchise, which originally debuted in March 2019. The gap between the two numbered entries does not mean the series has been dormant throughout that period: Tropico 6 received years' worth of post-launch additions , with its most recent expansion, Return to Nature , arriving in March 2025. Development has nevertheless changed hands for the sequel. Whereas Limbic Entertainment created Tropico 6 before Realmforge Studios took over its later support, Tropico 7 is being developed by fellow Kalypso subsidiary Gaming Minds Studios.
Tropico 7 Officially Confirmed as Part of Xbox Game Pass Wave 2 Lineup for January 2027
The seventh numbered entry in the popular franchise has recently locked down a release date: January 28, 2027. The move amounts to a small delay because the title was initially revealed as a 2026 title, albeit without ever narrowing down that release window any further. As originally announced, Tropico 7 will be a day-one addition to the Xbox Game Pass catalog . It will be available on the Xbox Series X/S and PC, as well as through Xbox Cloud Gaming. Its Xbox Store listing was also recently updated with the "handheld" label, indicating that the dictatorial city builder will be specifically optimized for devices such as the ROG Xbox Ally line.
The upcoming release will not be the first series entry to appear on Microsoft's subscription service, as Tropico 6 joined Xbox Game Pass in July 2021 . It remained in the catalog for roughly 18 months before departing on December 31, 2022. Tropico 7 will nevertheless make franchise history as the first installment to have a day-and-date launch on Xbox Game Pass. Under Microsoft's current catalog structure, the tropical city builder will initially be limited to the PC Game Pass and Ultimate tiers, as is standard for day-one releases. Tropico 7 is eventually expected to join the Xbox Game Pass Premium catalog as well. Based on the typical timing for third-party releases, its Premium-tier debut is most likely to fall between July 2027 and January 2028. If the game is only scheduled to remain on the service for the usual 12 months, that debut would be more likely to occur near the beginning of that window than the end.

Tropico 7 is the second January 2027 addition to Xbox Game Pass with an officially confirmed release date. The first one is Stranger Than Heaven , the ambitious Like a Dragon prequel from Ryu Ga Gotoku Studio.
Several other day-one titles are currently expected to join Xbox Game Pass in early 2027 . That group includes Raji: Kaliyuga , a dual-protagonist action adventure from India-based developer Nodding Head Games, which was previously announced for early 2027.
